# Most Expensive Coins

A running list of the strongest auction results for United States
coins.

As of 2019, the record price for any coin sold at auction is
$10,016,875, paid in January 2013 for the finest known 1794 Flowing
Hair dollar; no coin has ever sold for more. The result is widely read
as confirmation that the very top of the market behaves like fine art
rather than like bullion.

Other notable results include the 1913 Liberty Head nickel (Eliasberg
specimen, $4.56 million in 2018) and the 1804 Class I silver dollar
(Sultan of Muscat specimen, $4.1 million in 1999).

See [[Flowing Hair Dollar]] for the record coin itself.
